mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.5%, it signals restrictive monetary policy that suppresses economic activity and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong job growth (PAYEMS > 159,000) combined with low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) indicates a tight labor market supporting consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 159000 and UNRATE < 4.0, or interaction effect is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of strong retail sales (RSAFS > 700,000 million dollars), consumer spending growth fuels corporate revenue, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS > 700,000, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A lower unemployment rate (UNRATE) reflects a tight labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 320 and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) remains below 4.0%, the market perceives delayed monetary response to inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 320 and FEDFUNDS < 4.0, or interaction effect is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100), the market anticipates reduced corporate output and earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1250 thousand units, it signals strong economic activity and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1250, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
